import json, os, sys, shutil, uuid, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from public_process import invoke
from bootstrap import prepare
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import stress, verify

dep = prepare()
stage = '/tmp/stage-int'
shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
os.makedirs(stage)
# copy submission tree
for base,dirs,names in os.walk('/workspace/submission'):
    rel = os.path.relpath(base,'/workspace/submission')
    tgt = os.path.join(stage, rel) if rel!='.' else stage
    os.makedirs(tgt, exist_ok=True)
    for n in names:
        if n.endswith('.pyc'): continue
        shutil.copy2(os.path.join(base,n), os.path.join(tgt,n))
req = stress.build(3)
data = json.dumps(req, separators=(',',':')).encode()
tmp = '/tmp/int-tmp'
shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
start=time.time()
res = invoke('/workspace/check_worker', [sys.executable,'-B', os.path.join(stage,'main.py')], data, tmp, pythonpath=dep)
print('returncode', res.returncode, 'seconds %.2f'%res.seconds, 'stdout', len(res.stdout), 'stderr', len(res.stderr))
if res.stderr: print(res.stderr.decode()[:2000])
out = json.loads(res.stdout.decode())
assert 'error' not in out
verify.verify(req, out)
print('integration under check_worker: VERIFIED OK')
PYEOF
